decisions.reason: The machining sequence for surfaces 1 and 2 does not change the bushing's guidance, clearance fit, or retention method.
Finishing surfaces before welding does not alter the specified 45-degree angle between the lug hole axes.
The source changes fabrication sequencing but does not change any part material or drawing material-label requirement.
The pre-weld finishing decision does not change the piston-end arrangement or control-piston rod motion path.
The source changes when surfaces 1 and 2 are finished, not the main shaft's stock, dimensions, keyway, thread, or bushing-space geometry.
The fabrication-sequence clarification does not alter the assembly-based drawing-numbering rule.
The source does not change the requirement to deliver a 3D shaft assembly model; any design revision is governed by the fabrication requirement rather than the model-delivery attribute.
The source supplies fabrication content that drawings may need to reflect but does not change the independent requirement to provide a complete manufacturing drawing set.
